notes.title: ToLLA Release Announcement - September 15th, 2025.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/ab4a80f4670dfddd7924dbeba7b65324a79029ea.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]⚔️ Hail, adventurers! ⚔️[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]ToLLA has released! The game is live![/b]😎👇[/h3][p][/p][p]Apologies for the day-late announcement, but we stayed up all night prepping for launch, and then hanging around the Steam forums until early morning in case some critical bug needed patching. Luckily for us -- and most of you! -- only a few people ran into some minor issues, which we'll be looking to patch soon with the next update... as soon as we catch up on some sleep, heh.[/p][p][/p][p]If you've not already, consider grabbing the game while it's still hot off the presses![b] [/b]👇👇👇[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353220/Tales_of_Legendary_Lust_Aphrodisia/"][/dynamiclink]Or if you really want to splurge on some [b]lewds & art[/b], we also have a discounted bundle available:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59320/Tales_of_Legendary_Lust_Aphrodisia__Collectors_Edition/"][/dynamiclink]We'll talk about roadmap and future plans in a sec, but before we get to that...[/p][p][/p][p][b]We just wanna say that we'd like to thank all of you for your support![/b] Everyone who sent us feedback, who wishlisted the game, who purchased it, who left a review, who played the demo during [i][b]Next Fest[/b][/i] and sent us bug reports, and who supported us either on Itch or Patreon - thank you! We can only be developers if we have players who actually play our games, and all of you are what makes that possible! So thank you for supporting us, and for believing in our vision and this project!❤️❤️❤️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/d4f922f2b3cbad149a0be831ac5465824d0d95a7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]So what's next for us and the game?[/b][/h3][p]First we need to gather feedback and see what needs patching.[/p][p]Then we'll take a day or two off to catch up on sleep and recharge...[/p][p]We'll try and roll out a post-launch patch by the end of this week, here on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Once that's done, we're pivoting to getting achievements finished and implemented.[/b] Many of you expressed a desire for them, and we'll do our best to deliver. After that's done, we'd like to roll out another [b]2-3 small patches[/b] for the game... there's some SFW content we had to cut from the final release because it wasn't tested properly, and we didn't want y'all to run into bugs playing. We'll probably add a couple more NPCs to the [b]Southern Wildlands[/b] to flesh out the area a bit more, and wrap up their stories.[/p][p][/p][h2]Once that's all done and dusted, we're going to pivot full steam ahead on the major expansion!😎👍[/h2][p][/p][p]You can read everything about it in the previous devlog here, or check out the Steam page:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4000920/Tales_of_Legendary_Lust_Aphrodisia__Through_Stone__Steel/"][/dynamiclink]As always, wishlists are the lifeblood of Steam projects, so please hit that WL button above.👆👆👆[/p][p][/p][p]We'd like to get the first major expansion done by [b]Q2 2026[/b] if possible. We already have a portion of the maps and lewds and assets finished, but it's all disconnected and still needs work. Combat as well needs implementing (it's mostly in the design phase), and inventory management on top of that.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We'll keep y'all updated with regular blogs and announcements here as we make progress![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/078e479fcc356dbfeacb2abeb6cbc15c3bd0fb14.png"][/img][/p][p]In the meantime, don't hesitate to drop us a line here on the [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2353220"]Steam forums[/url][/b], whether that's to post feedback, inquire about the game, or just chat a bit. You can also reach us on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/crimdelgames.bsky.social"][b]Bluesky[/b][/url] for DMs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]One small favor we'd like to ask is that you consider leaving a review if you've purchased the game[/b], it massively helps with surfacing on the platform, and the Steam algo won't throttle visibility once a game gets to 10 reviews. So consider dropping one if you can, it can be very short![/p][p][/p][h3]And don't forget to follow us here on Steam so you're notified of updates:[/h3][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/CrimsonDelightGames"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/CrimsonDelightGames[/url][/h3][p][/p][p]Anyway, that's it for now - we'll be back once we have the next patch & update ready![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your support! Take care and stay safe...[/p][p][/p][p]Much love,[/p][p][i][b]~ the CDG team [/b][/i]❤️[/p]

notes.title: ToLLA Devlog & Update - August 22nd, 2025.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/ab4a80f4670dfddd7924dbeba7b65324a79029ea.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]⚔️ Hail, adventurers! ⚔️[/h2][p][/p][h3]We're back with yet another [b]ToLLA[/b] devlog!😎👇[/h3][p][/p][p]Just a quick update for y'all first - we're still in the process of getting the release build approved by [b]Valve.[/b] They usually give extra scrutiny to adult games to ensure there's no problematic content in there. The recent payment processor situation and crackdown have probably made things even slower. As such, we've had to push back the release date by a little bit while we wait to get the game approved. [b]ToLLA[/b] should be out around the start of [b]September[/b], give or take a few days...[/p][p][/p][p]As always, you can [b]wishlist[/b] the game right here on [b]Steam: [/b]👇👇👇[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353220/Tales_of_Legendary_Lust_Aphrodisia/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Now on to the devlog...[/h3][p][/p][p]We've recently been working on the huge [b]Fort Ninevus[/b] area, which will probably be released as a [b]free DLC[/b] post-launch. [b]The Fort[/b] is a massive map - lots of structures, NPCs, and story content. There's a monstrous amount of work to chew through, but we're getting there! Today we'll talk about the art pipeline a bit, and how we go about creating the game visuals...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/4eecf8026e2225c8d095f3a5530fc5b4bd3729eb.png"][/img][/p][p]All art content in [b]ToLLA[/b] is made by hand. Every building, character, lewd pic, miniature, interaction icon, down to the smallest blade of grass is painted by one of our two artists. it's a slow and painstaking process, but the end result looks great and gives the game a unique [b]old-school 80s cartoon-y vibe...[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/496e07384bd27ca09bf85d807cf23d5cc5068a37.png"][/img][/p][p]Game areas start out as [b]concept sketches[/b] where we block out the [b]landmarks[/b] and other important locations. Once that's done, the art passes through multiple drafts, going from blocky and simple to full-rez and [b]"baked"[/b] onto the underlying grass map. Shadows are painted on top, and the layers are all crunched and composited together, then exported into a format the game engine can read... On top of that we add some creative scripting and code magic to get dynamic effects like the [b]day & night cycle[/b], and things like transparency for sprites when they pass behind tress and other large obstacles like buildings. Final additions are the [b]pathing map, and interaction icons...[/b] The comparison below shows how a game map goes from simple concept to final in-game asset; this is the [b]Southern Wildlands[/b] zone, which is the second large area you'll visit with your party...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/071aaadc7e96d38ae9ece78475a59622c5d71ca6.png"][/img][/p][p]We use a similar pipeline for creating big and detailed objects like buildings. They all start as simple sketches that demonstrate a concept. The ones below are from the [b]Fort Ninevus[/b] area...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/275ad72234ecbc9e6af03782c577a54951093343.png"][/img][/p][p]Then one of our artists (usually our [b]art lead[/b]) will develop the concept through a series of drafts... [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/5b8d4c54e8de16c35da39deef353f05b17c62bc9.png"][/img][/p][p]And once she's finished, we get the final [b]in-game asset[/b] that's added to the pathable map...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/cbb53ec95024b63d0d9fcd4e7c70eca4de5c3cf9.png"][/img][/p][p]There's always been a trend in gamedev to choose [b]3D[/b] over [b]2D[/b] due to speed of production, but we're fans of old-school aesthetics and love the cartoony hand-painted look. The downside to that is how [b]labor-intensive[/b] every piece is, and depending on complexity can take many hours to go from sketch to final asset. Blocking them out is the easy part; inking and coloring is what takes up most of the time, and even a [b]"simple" watchtower[/b] is the end result of days of work...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/a5f376b3acc51f0458d43f0a8a0a625c2c8f5b02.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Character art[/b] is done much the same way. All characters begin life as concept sketches where their features and proportions are rendered by hand from a rough idea pulled out of our design docs...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/4cbb0909be1df4a46d500163ae234086fd3276a8.png"][/img][/p][p]Then the chosen portrait goes through [b]multiple passes...[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/6358bb7858ec6a603eafbfc0355ad2a1b9f7d211.png"][/img][/p][p]Until the [b]final version[/b] is polished to standard and is added to the game...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/5b92330871cd5399ae8bc4867048cfd784738f94.png"][/img][/p][p]We currently have [b]two artists[/b] on the team, but we're hoping to expand that in the future when funds allow... as well as producing [b]free DLCs[/b] for the game once it's out. Currently art is our biggest bottleneck, so having more hands on deck would go a long way toward speeding up production. We'll continue working on the DLC in the meantime, and hope to have it out some time after launch...[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here's the changelog for this internal update:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]fixed some typos and improved the general flow of Felicia's convos[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]added a unique tavern background to Felicia's convo in the Smoky Stag interior area[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]added dedicated exit-game icons (azure arrow icons, located by the save-game floppy disks in the game world)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]added full VO to Felicia's talks and quest, clocking in at over 45min of spoken dialogue (Felicia, Meredith, Captain Hale)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]added the 3 overworld secret merchant cards to the world... currently placeholders for item shops that'll be added later (orcess, drow, siren)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]repainted image #12's holdover background in Sabrine's lewd scene from old beige to new green (thanks MacroMike172 for pointing this out to us!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]recolored the compass icons in Ninevus South & Southern Wildlands areas from sepia to azure, to differentiate them from the surrounding icons[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]fixed a small but annoying pathfinding bug that was affecting some players (thanks to everyone who sent us saved games for debugging!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]finally located and fixed the VO overlap bug on Hale's lines at the Main Gate event... hopefully that's the last of it![/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]added two single-image lewd memories featuring Meredith... full scenes will unlock once inside Fort Ninevus![/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's it for this [b]devlog[/b], we hope you enjoyed it! We'll be back when we have more news... might do a post about our asset library next. In the meantime, don't forget to follow us directly here on Steam if you'd like to keep up with our work: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/CrimsonDelightGames"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/CrimsonDelightGames[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Much love,[/p][p][b][i]~ the CDG team [/i][/b]❤️[/p]

notes.title: ToLLA Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810254/40ca437f630389900fa8122acc7fa4fe0e138a60.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Hail, adventurers! ⚔️[/h2]

We've set the game's [b]Early Access[/b] release date to the end of August. In the meantime, work continues on new content, with a focus on story progression. We'll be working hard all summer to expand and polish [i][b]ToLLA[/b][/i] in preparation for a Steam release; we plan to launch in [b]EA[/b] with 35+ hours of content, after which we'll continue refining the game based on player feedback, and doing a pass on mechanics...

If you have any questions or suggestions you can post a thread in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2353220/discussions/]discussions sub-forum[/url], or contact us directly on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/crimdelgames.bsky.social]Bluesky.[/url]

And don't forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game if you'd like to be notified when it releases!😉👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353220/
